primary_source: Marcus, Spielman, Srivastava, Interlacing Families II: Mixed Characteristic Polynomials and the Kadison-Singer Problem, arXiv:1306.3969v4 (2014)

input_paraphrase: For independent finite-support vectors with total expected outer product equal to identity and each expected squared norm at most epsilon, an outcome has outer-product-sum norm at most (1+sqrt(epsilon))^2. The stated frame partition corollary supplies matrix upper bounds; the extra simultaneous cardinality statement needed by candidate244 is derived in that candidate using an auxiliary signed coordinate.
